limitations: Historical Euler pose, beta, altitude/actual density, IAS-to-TAS conversion, PG Mach, initial influence toggle, stall settings, Fourier truncation and actual node coordinates are not recorded in these tables. No matching .set/.pnt/.con exists in this family. Absence from the retained archive does not prove the files were absent when ASWING ran.
The absolute executable path ASWING_ISAE_ENAC is a provenance token, not a recoverable source version or settings manifest.
The four angles11.25,11.50,11.75,12.00 are absent in both every driver and table: no rows can be recovered at those coordinates. All510 stored rows and2040 raw coefficients remain required.

Pitch=alpha, beta0 and horizontal freestream are an explicit conditional comparison convention, not historical reconstruction. Zero Euler attitude is a different diagnostic, not silently interchangeable.

The flapped input uses section alpha12.5, dCLda7.44, CLmax2.6, Cdf.04; its geometric twist remains0 and all flap derivatives0. Preserve these as literal section constants, not a12.5-degree geometric pitch or a deflected slot.
Both inputs keep exact Sref.3871 rather than chord*span.387096, Cref.254 and Bref1.524. Preserve zero Cm, all mass/stiffness entries and the flapped shortened zero-valued tables unchanged.
All six table conv flags are1, but this is original archive metadata, not proof that a new run converges or recovers the historical operating state.

The old isae_sa12_reference.py note claiming a documented frozen default is not supported by the reviewed K/F passage. In any event one toggle with unknown restored startup state cannot establish the historical selected mode.
No experimental agreement, fitted angle shift, drag substitution, engine/flap adjustment or new solver validity claim is part of this audit.
wrapper_requirements: Pin byte-exact model/driver/table and keep each raw row token, index, t, conv, stall, alpha and four target coefficients. Compute printed-precision half units from each token exponent, including tiny signed CM values; no fixed tolerance substitution.

Forward ground_effect=1 and ground_normal=[0,0,1] for every height including1000. Set position_earth=[0,0,h] explicitly. Forward chosen attitude, speed/density/altitude/PG/influence settings and describe unrecorded values as declared assumptions.

Under a declared pitch=alpha setup, independently verify normal_body=[-sin(alpha),0,cos(alpha)], offset=h, normal_earth=[0,0,1], returned position/attitude, ground flag/kind, and dot(normal_body,wind)=0. Do not infer pitch from section alpha.

Verify positive minimum sampled full-chord clearance from actual geometry; axis-only height is insufficient. Literal flat wing LE andTE are x=-.25c and+.75c. With pitch=alpha the heights are h+.25c*sin(alpha) and h-.75c*sin(alpha). This checks the equivalent line geometry, not a physical flap tip.

Preserve the full result with strips, Gamma/local residuals, force, moment, atmosphere, lifting-airflow validity, mesh, ground_plane, trefftz and limitation fields. Reconstruct physical F=sum(strip.force) and M=sum((strip.position-Xmom)cross strip.force+strip.moment); image loads are not added as physical forces.

Use qS=.5*rho*U^2*Sref and wind=[cos(alpha),0,sin(alpha)], lift=[-sin(alpha),0,cos(alpha)]. Independently check CL=F dot lift/qS,CD=F dot wind/qS,CY=Fy/qS,Cm=My/(qS*Cref),Cl=-Mx/(qS*Bref),Cn=-Mz/(qS*Bref). Check other body/engine/apparent terms are zero for the literal rigid no-motion configuration or include them explicitly.

Keep total CD versus CDi_near+CDp+CDbody+CDam+CDeng+CDrate as a separate identity. Archived CDi maps to available Trefftz CDi, not near-field induced drag; null/unavailable remains a required unmet output, with the reason retained.

Do not identify new requested intervals with original NODE I100. Retain actual nodes/elements and independent mesh comparisons. No whole-family or exact historical setup pass follows merely from numerical checks.

source_locators.supports: Ground input block is a beam support; type0 rigidly restrains translation and rotation, separate from aerodynamic images.
Xax is axis distance/chord from leading edge; section alpha is zero-lift-line angle above c-axis, not aircraft Euler pitch.
Command-line model name auto-loads matching .set/.pnt/.con, if present.
Static Earth coordinates and Euler angles must be specified; they are not free static unknowns.
% keyboard constraint selection; A anchored defaults, D done. Five drivers select A; No_Flap_inf does not.
!V is IAS; !A aerodynamic alpha; !RX/RY/RZ Earth position; !Ex/Ey/Ez bank/elevation/heading.
K/F toggles frozen jig zero-alpha/beta influence versus updated wind-aligned influence. This passage does not establish actual startup toggle state.
Atmospheric altitude is a separate setting; ground flag+1 solid, image plane through Earth origin, normal Earth axes, Earth position/Euler angles determine clearance. Flag per point, normal common.
Earth X=R+Te*x; !Rz belongs to aircraft origin, not a body-coordinate lift-axis displacement.
NODE I requests number of nodes; ASWING may raise it to satisfy breakpoints. Does not provide original actual node array.
